Usage: sink check [OPTIONS] [SERVER_NAMES]...

  Test server settings in config.

Options:
  -R, --required
  --insecure                   Do not verify TLS certificates.
  --trust-config               Run probes even if the config is untrusted.
  --strict / --allow-failures  Exit non-zero on probe failure (default), or
                               allow failures.
  --json                       Emit probe results as JSON.
  -h, --help                   Show this message and exit.
